The '''father''' of [[Allania Jakien]] lived on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked in the [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas refinery. During the [[Occupation of Bespin|take over]] of Cloud City by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], he escaped with his family aboard a crowded [[Transport/Legends|transport]].<ref name="LGL" />
